findings.body: The activation-transition rewrite was blocked, but validated evidence remains mutable through an update that leaves `state = 'validated'`. This condition protects only `validated` → `active`; a caller can first rewrite counts, coverage, validation/reconciliation results, errors, or `validated_at_utc` while keeping the row validated, then activate it unchanged. The new test exercises only rewriting during activation, so the supposedly validated evidence can still be replaced before activation. Freeze validation evidence whenever `OLD.state = 'validated'`, with only the permitted lifecycle fields changing.
findings.title: Not done: immutable ingestion lifecycle

findings.body: The prior scope finding remains open: this SCHEMA branch still rewrites the named acceptance coverage for the later MODEL and MEMORY tasks, along with their plan/read metadata. These changes are outside the explicitly permitted SCHEMA paths and are unnecessary for delivering the eight additive tables and generation constraints. They should remain with their owning tasks or a separately approved planning change.
findings.title: Remove out-of-scope changes to future MODEL and MEMORY tasks
